subject: Vendor portal activation + PO field & MSA redline items
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brightleafhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightleafhealth.com
Date: 2027-03-18 09:12 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal activation + MSA clarifications

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We're starting the portal activation for Brightleaf and a couple of items came up that will block the Coupa/Ariba onboarding until resolved: 

- Our AP team needs clarity on the PO field that carries the internal GL code. Brightleaf expects an explicit BuyerAccountNumber/CostCenter field; current sample POs from Redwood don't include that mapping.
- The order acknowledgement window: our standard is 48 hours. Will Redwood enforce ACK-by window in the integration?
- Security/legal asked for the updated MSA with the AWS data-residency clause added; procurement needs the redline before we can route to our legal counsel.

I've attached a short file with the AP team's required PO fields (PO_field_mapping_matrix.xlsx). Can you route the MSA redline to your legal contact and confirm the PO field mapping and ACK SLA?

Goal: finish portal registration and enable test PO flow by March 25.

Best,
Hannah Lee
Procurement Manager, Brightleaf Health
[Attachment: PO_field_mapping_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brightleafhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-18 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal activation + MSA clarifications

Hannah — thanks, got it. Looping in Marissa (legal) and Olga (onboarding/ops). Quick answers while they review: 

- PO fields: we can surface a BuyerAccountNumber and map to CostCenter or GL in our PO payload. I asked Ops to draft a field mapping spreadsheet and will attach.
- ACK window: the runtime ACK policy is configurable per-customer. Default in the Coupa adapter is 72 hours, but we can enforce a 48-hour ACK for Brightleaf on Dedicated/Dedicated-Peak config.
- MSA redline: Marissa, can you confirm whether the AWS data-residency clause can be added and provide the redline back to Brightleaf this afternoon?

Next steps I propose: Marissa reviews the redline, Ops (Olga) validates the mapping matrix and SFTP/EDI details, then we schedule a 30-min call to confirm test PO format. Can we aim for that call on Thursday?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.com
[Sent from mobile]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brightleafhealth.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-18 14:22 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal activation + MSA clarifications

Hi all — attaching an initial redline with the AWS data-residency paragraph inserted (see section 7.b). I flagged two items that will need Brightleaf confirmation: 

1) Data access during incident response: we propose an Operating Access model for debug that avoids cross-border replication; Brightleaf legal asked for stronger control — please advise if you need a specific IP allowlist or platform-level access windows.
2) Indemnity cap carveouts: we kept Redwood's standard cap but added a clause to address data-processing regulatory fines; Brightleaf may request a carveout.

I've attached: Redwood_MSA_redline_v2.docx (redline). Olga — once Hannah confirms PO fields, please add the field mapping as a small JSON/EDI sample to the onboarding folder.

Hoping to get Brightleaf legal's comments by Friday so we can keep the activation target.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MSA_redline_v2.docx (docx, 128KB)]

From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brightleafhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightleafhealth.com, legal@brightleafhealth.com
Date: 2027-03-19 10:08 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal activation + MSA clarifications

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few notes from Brightleaf legal and AP after an internal review: 

- Data access windows: legal would accept time-boxed debug access (up to 4 hours) plus a documented request/approval workflow; IP allowlist preferred but optional.
- Indemnity carveout: legal will request that regulatory fines related to patient data (PHI) be carved out; they'll propose language by end of day Friday.

AP notes on PO fields (from the attached matrix): 
- BuyerAccountNumber: required (map to accounting_code)
- ShipToCode: optional, but when present must map to ShipToCode element in Ariba POs
- TaxJurisdiction: Brightleaf requires the jurisdiction element populated for tax validation; if empty, AP will reject the PO.

Operational ask: can Redwood publish an example Ariba XML PO that includes BuyerAccountNumber and TaxJurisdiction? That will speed test integration.

We can do the short sync tomorrow at 11am PT to go over the mapping and test cadence.

Best,
Hannah

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@brightleafhealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-21 16:04 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal activation + MSA clarifications

Hi Hannah — following up after our internal ops review and the call this morning. Action summary and owners: 

- Olga (Redwood Ops): produce sample Ariba XML PO with BuyerAccountNumber, ShipToCode, TaxJurisdiction; provide SFTP drop credential template. Deliverable due: 2027-03-23. [Attachment: PO_field_mapping_matrix_filled.xlsx]
- Marissa (Redwood Legal): await Brightleaf proposed indemnity carveout language; Redwood to respond with counter-language if needed. Target review complete: 2027-03-26.
- Karthik (AE): coordinate commercial sign-off and confirm ACK SLA (48h) to be applied to Brightleaf account settings post-signature.
- Brightleaf (Hannah/legal): circulate the indemnity language and confirm acceptance of time-boxed debug access. Target: 2027-03-26.

Notes: 1) For Ariba/Coupa enrollment, we recommend Brightleaf select SFTP integration for test POs first; if EDI is preferred later, we will convert mappings to EDI-850 format. 2) If TaxJurisdiction is not present in the portal feed, Redwood can flag the PO as "requires manual review" which will cause a delay — better to include the field.

Please confirm the action plan and I'll open the onboarding ticket and health-check timeline in our portal (link below).

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_field_mapping_matrix_filled.xlsx (xlsx, 30KB)]
